notes: A ONE-CLICK MONTH-END PACK: Month-End Close now prints the month's filing pack as one document - a cover with the checklist and sign-off lines, the Trial Balance, Income and Expenditure, Statement of Financial Position and Cash Flows for the month, and every bank's reconciliation status. SWITCH OFF WHAT YOU DO NOT USE: Settings, Modules hides budgets, payroll, fuel coupons and the rest from the menu; nothing is deleted and switching one back on restores it exactly. PRINT FROM THE MENU: File, Print (Cmd+P or Ctrl+P) prints the document on screen, and Help opens the User Guide. FIXED: staff advance retirements and write-offs carry their own date instead of always today, and cash handed back is recorded on the retirement itself; Revalue starts from the asset's book value, not its original cost. Printed reports are tighter, the app has a new balanced T-account icon, and the User Guide covers all of it. THE APP IS NOW CALLED MORAJ LEDGER: your books stay exactly where they are. On a Mac, after installing, drag the old MoRaj Finance Suite app to the Bin. Installing: nothing in the ledger changes. Please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
